verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at help.shopify.com (HTTP 200), explicitly titled as a guide for AI agents and crawlers. The cited POS help and shopify.dev pages are served as .md URLs, so agent-readable markdown docs exist. The .md.md 404 is only a malformed double-extension request, not a counter-example. Missing for 10: POS-specific agent-oriented content in the llms.txt (the probe excerpt is truncated and Help-Center-wide), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
